title: OpenAPI plugin additional settings
description: Settings that control OpenAPI specification import, base URL overrides, and operation exposure.

base_url.description: Resolved API base URL used by the connector.

base_url_override.description: Whether the action uses a manually overridden base URL instead of the specification server.

allowed_operations.description: Optional list of operation IDs or generated operation keys exposed to agents. Missing or empty means all operations are available.

openapi_source_type.description: How the specification content is stored.
